newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran oil exploration southwest of Tehran completed.
newsitem.headline: Iran oil exploration southwest of Tehran completed.

text.p: Iran has successfully completed the first phase of a petroleum seismological survey near Saveh, 130 km (81 miles) southwest of Tehran, an oil official said in remarks published on Monday.

Bahram Ahmadzadeh, head of geophysics operations at the National Iranian Oil Company, said the seimological study was carried out in a 3,000 square km area (1,160 square miles) based on "positive results" from a geological survey of the region, the daily Resalat said.
The second phase of the survey was being carried out in a 12,000 square km (4,630 square miles) area stretching from Saveh to parts of Qom and Kashan provinces, Ahmadzadeh added.
